issuer.entity: f(x) Protocol contributors; incorporated fxSAVE repayment obligor unestablished
issuer.summary: Ethereum fxSAVE is a Concentrator ERC-4626 vault share. Direct redemption returns fxSP, the Stability Pool share. Redeeming fxSP yields the pool-dependent mix of fxUSD and USDC. Receiving only USDC can require converting the fxUSD leg at an acceptable price. The documented atomic route charges a fee and the alternative requires a cooldown. Neither a funded cash exit nor a guaranteed yield was established.
facts: The March 5, 2026 interface terms identify DAO contributors and community members as counterparties and disclaim a legal entity, fiduciary duties, insurance and responsibility for protocol losses. They provide individual binding arbitration with contributors and a class waiver. No governing law, arbitration seat or administrator was identified in those terms. The interface restricts US, Canadian, mainland Chinese and specified sanctioned users. These statements describe interface access and contractual disclaimers; independent enforceability and corporate registry status remain unverified. No independent fxSAVE wrapper repayment or yield obligor was identified.

Ethereum fxSAVE is a Concentrator ERC-4626 vault share. Direct redemption returns fxSP, the Stability Pool share. Redeeming fxSP yields the pool-dependent mix of fxUSD and USDC. Receiving only USDC can require converting the fxUSD leg at an acceptable price. The documented atomic route charges a fee and the alternative requires a cooldown. Neither a funded cash exit nor a guaranteed yield was established.

FXN lockers can participate through veFXN. On November 27 the newest proposal returned by the fxn.eth Snapshot space was FIP-30, an OUSD/fxUSD gauge proposal ending February 9, 2026. No subsequent issuer-rights change was identified in the reviewed terms, documentation and vote history. Votes do not establish execution or capture every multisig, parameter or upgrade action.

The audit index lists an fxSAVE review. The vault, fxSP, router and converter each require their own version and deployment checks. Upstream fxUSD collateral ratios do not measure vault backing. No signed financial statement audit, independent reserve opinion, holder-specific insolvency priority or current audit-to-deployment equivalence was established.

The operator described the February 2, 2025 keeper outage and its addition of keeper/RPC redundancy. ChainSecurity disclosed a patched April 2025 access-control issue on June 17. These are historical protocol events. The reviewed sources establish neither a new component-specific loss nor a compensation obligation.
Family interface terms effectiveMarch5 describe a DAO without a legal entity and disclaim fiduciary duties and insurance. No incorporated token repayment obligor established.
Exact fxSAVE component redeems through fxSP into fxUSD plus USDC; it does not inherit an unconditional fxUSD dollar redemption right.
Public source/disclosures are positive accountability evidence with limits; corporate principals, governing law/clear arbitration seat and comprehensive conduct assurance remain unestablished.
Code audit matches, collateral quality and timelock quorums belong to other risk axes; they do not justify this issuer grade.
